title: Light Crispy Uruguayan Corn Tacos
description: Fresh corn tortillas filled with crispy yuzu cured vegetables, served on a lazy susan spinner, this dish is a nostalgic Uruguayan favorite, ayurvedic tamasic friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the shredded cabbage, grated carrots, and thinly sliced red onion.
Pour the yuzu juice over the vegetable mixture and toss to coat.
Let the vegetable mixture sit for at least 10 minutes to allow the yuzu cure to set.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the vegetable mixture from the yuzu juice and set aside.
Fry the corn tortillas in the hot oil for 30 seconds on each side, until crispy and golden brown.
Remove the fried tortillas from the oil and place on a paper towel lined plate to drain excess oil.
To assemble the tacos, place a few pieces of the yuzu cured vegetable mixture onto a fried tortilla and top with chopped cilantro and a squeeze of lime juice.
Serve the tacos on a lazy susan spinner and enjoy.
